headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk assessment into ClearInstall to provide users with up-to-date information on potential vulnerabilities and risks associated with npm/PyPI packages, including command expansion issues. This will help developers make informed decisions before running installations.
